A fix for the check of the PLC certificate. **Upgrade if the CA of your TIA Portal project signs
the PLC certificate** ("Use global security settings for certificate manager") and you use the
check *trusted certificate or project CA*.

## Highlights

- **Trusting the PLC certificate itself works for CA-signed certificates.** Before this release,
  when the project CA signed the PLC certificate, the check refused the PLC certificate itself
  as trusted certificate ("is not signed by a trusted certificate"). This is what *Use this
  certificate* in the endpoint editor copies, so the editor flow did not work with a project CA.
  It worked only with the CA, or with a self-signed PLC certificate. Now the exact PLC
  certificate is accepted; its dates and name are still checked. Risk: none; before, the
  connection was refused, no wrong certificate was accepted.

Tested on PLCSIM Advanced V8 (S7-1500, FW S4.1) with a PLC certificate signed by the TIA Portal
V21 project CA: the project CA, the PLC certificate and the fingerprint connect; another CA, a
wrong name and a wrong fingerprint are refused.

## Upgrade notes

- None.
